record.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the doctrine of Res Sub Judice under Section 10 of the Civil Procedure Code, 1908?
options: It bars the institution of a subsequent suit in a court of concurrent jurisdiction
It prohibits the simultaneous trial of two suits in which the matter in issue is directly and substantially the same
It applies only when the previously instituted suit is pending in a foreign court
The court has the discretion to either proceed with or stay the later suit depending on the circumstances
